about.title: About Us
about.content: NurApps is a team of developers building high-quality open-source applications. Our mission is to make technology accessible to everyone. All our projects are distributed under open licenses, and we welcome community contributions.

questions.a: NurApps is a team of developers creating free open-source applications for various platforms.
Yes, all our apps are completely free and distributed under open licenses (MIT, GPL, AGPL).
You can fork our repository on GitHub, make changes, and create a Pull Request. We review all contributions.
Our apps are available for Windows, Android, Linux, and web browsers. Each app lists its supported platforms.

questions.q: How do I report a bug?
questions.a: Go to the Issues section of the corresponding GitHub repository and create a new issue describing the problem.
We release updates as needed. All updates are automatically reflected on the website.
